primaryTextRead.text: the son of a woman of the daughters of Dan; and his father was a man of Tyre. He is skillful to work in gold, in silver, in bronze, in iron, in stone, in timber, in purple, in blue, in fine linen, and in crimson, also to engrave any kind of engraving and to devise any device, that there may be a place appointed to him with your skillful men, and with the skillful men of my lord David your father.

primaryTextRead.text: Ben Hadad listened to King Asa, and sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel; and they struck Ijon, Dan, Abel Maim, and all the storage cities of Naphtali.

primaryTextRead.text: So they established a decree to make proclamation throughout all Israel, from Beersheba even to Dan, that they should come to keep the Passover to the LORD, the God of Israel, at Jerusalem, for they had not kept it in great numbers in the way it is written.

wikipediaRead.title: Tribe of Dan
wikipediaRead.locator: L142–146 identifies the subject as the Israelite tribe; L169–170 describes its place in the united monarchy. Used only as group background, not a claim that the woman in 2 Chronicles 2:14 is the eponymous ancestor.

wikipediaRead.identityAssessmentJa: The article’s subject is the collective tribe. It is related background to the group designation, not evidence about an individual ancestor.
